blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-policy distillation trains a student on its own rollouts, so states the teacher would reach but the student does not are seldom supervised. We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), which keeps the on-policy loss and moves only the distribution of training states toward the teacher, drawing rollouts from a geometric interpolation of student and teacher through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding. The coupling keeps the student's token wherever the two distributions agree and otherwise substitutes a token from the part of the target the student underweights, so interventions are as rare as any exact sampler allows and recede as the student learns. Across six base students from two model families (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B to 4B), CoRD raises average pass@1 over on-policy distillation by 0.9 to 2.0 points and pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points on five public math benchmarks at equal steps and data. On frozen teacher-reached states, a 4B student trained with CoRD reaches in 16 steps a gap closure that on-policy distillation does not reach in 80, and substitution rules intervening at least as often in other directions fall short of CoRD.
blocks.zh: 政策上的提炼训练学生自己推出, 我们引入了CoRD(连锁-推出蒸馏),它保持了政策上的亏损,只将培训状态的分布转向教师,通过最大程度的投机解码组合从学生和教师的几何插图中抽取出。 无论两种分配方式如何商定,组合都保留学生的象征,否则就取代了学生体重不足的目标部分的象征,因此干预像任何精确的采样者所允许的和学生所学习的一样少见. 来自两个模范家庭(Qune3和Qune3.5, 0.6B至4B)的6个基础学生中,CORD将政策提炼的平均通过度@1提高0.9至2.0分,并在5个公共数学基准上以相等的步数和数据通过0.2至3.4分。 在被冻结的教师接触的州,一名接受过CORD训练的4B学生在16个步骤中达到了一个缺口的关闭,而政策蒸馏没有达到80个,而替代规则干预其他方向至少经常低于CORD。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has been driven by complementary progress in model architectures ( He et al., 2016 ; Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) , data scale and quality ( Yuan et al., 2023 ; Rao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026b ) , and training paradigms ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . Current research frontiers span theoretical explorations of learning dynamics and generalization ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , generation across various modalities ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2026 ) , tool-augmented reasoning ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and interdisciplinary applications ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Within this broad landscape, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a central paradigm for exploring complex reasoning and knowledge transfer. A key challenge is how to enable smaller student models to efficiently inherit the capabilities of stronger teachers.
blocks.zh: 人工智能的快速发展,得益于模型架构(He等人,2016年;Vaswani等人,2017年;Yu等人,2026a),数据尺度和质量(Yuan等人,2023年;Rao等人,2025年;Yu等人,2026年b)以及培训范式(Oyang等人,2022年)的互补进展. 目前的研究前沿跨越了对学习动力学和概括学的理论探索(Chen等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年;Yu等人,2025年),跨越多种模式的一代(Yu等人,2024年;Tian等人,2026年),工具化推理(Wu等人,2025年),跨学科应用(Liu等人,2026年a年). 在这个广阔的地貌中,大型语言模型(LLMS)已成为探索复杂推理和知识转移的中心范式. 一个关键的挑战是如何使较小的学生模式有效地继承更强大的教师的能力。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of CoRD . (i) Left (OPD’s blind spot): On-policy distillation trains only on student rollouts. Teacher-preferred reasoning paths that the student rarely or never visits therefore receive little or no supervision. (ii) Right (our coupled sampler): CoRD keeps the same training loss and budget, but changes the rollout sampler. By coupling the student with a teacher-leaning target q α q_{\alpha} , it preserves agreeing tokens and replaces disagreements with underweighted target tokens. This maximal coupling steers rollouts into teacher-preferred states missed by OPD with the minimum possible intervention rate, minimally perturbing the student’s original trajectory.

blocks.en: Among knowledge distillation methods, on-policy distillation (OPD) has become a commonly used approach to this challenge Agarwal et al. (2024) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2024) . The student generates its own rollouts and is trained to match the teacher’s full next-token distribution at every state it visits, usually by minimizing the reverse Kullback–Leibler divergence. Training on self-generated text removes the mismatch between teacher-forced training and free-running generation Bengio et al. (2015) ; Ranzato et al. (2016) ; Ross et al. (2011) , and the teacher’s dense, token-level signal replaces the single final reward of reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 在知识蒸馏方法中,政策蒸馏(OPD)已成为应对这一挑战的常用方法Agarwal等人(2024年);Gu等人(2024年);Yang等人(2025年);徐等人(2024年)。 学生自行推出课程,并接受培训,以配合教师在所访问的每个州的全部接吻分布,通常通过尽量减少反向的Kullback-Leibler差异。 自我生成文本的培训消除了师资强化培训与自由经营一代Bengio等人(2015年),Ranzato等人(2016年),Ross等人(2011年)之间的不匹配,教师密集的象征性信号取代了强化学习的单一最终奖励.

blocks.en: The same design also fixes where the supervision lands. Because states are drawn from the student, the teacher only ever comments on states the student already reaches. States the teacher would enter, such as the first step of a solution path the student considers unlikely, are sampled only as often as the student itself picks them, and corrected only that often. We measure this blind spot on frozen sets of states. Before training, the student is 1.5 to 2.4 times further from the teacher on states reached by the teacher’s distribution than on states it reaches itself, across the four students analyzed in Section 5 . On-policy training closes this gap only slowly: after 40 steps at 4B, OPD has removed 15.0% of the divergence on teacher-reached states, where the sampler we introduce removes 21.7%.
blocks.zh: 同样的设计也规定了监管者落地地点。 因为州是来自学生, 老师只评论学生已经到达的州。 教师将进入的国家,如学生认为不太可能的解决途径的第一步,只有在学生自己挑选时才进行抽样,而且只有这样经常纠正。 我们测量冷冻状态的盲点 在培训前,该学生在教师分配达到的状态方面比在5节分析的4名学生中达到的状态方面比教师本人高出1.5至2.4倍。 政策培训缓慢地缩小了这一差距:在4B的40个步骤之后,OPD已经消除了15.0%的师资联系州的分歧,我们引进的抽样人员取消了21.7%。

blocks.en: Reaching those states requires steering the rollout toward the teacher while leaving it the student’s own text wherever the two agree. Speculative decoding already contains the right tool Leviathan et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023) . Its rejection sampler, usually seen as an accelerator, realizes the maximal coupling of two token distributions Lindvall (1992) : a draft token is kept where the distributions agree and replaced by a draw from their difference where they do not. When used instead as a training sampler, this rule intervenes only where the student and the target disagree, and exactly as often as they disagree.
blocks.zh: 联系这些州需要引导老师, 光谱解码已经包含了正确的工具Leviathan等人(2023年);陈等人(2023年). 它的拒绝采样器,通常被视为加速器,实现了两个令牌发行量的最大耦合(Lindvall (1992): 代号草稿保存在分发双方同意的地方,代之以从它们之间的差额中抽取的代号。 当作为训练抽样者使用时,这一规则只有在学生和目标有分歧时才进行干预,而且与他们有分歧时一样频繁。

blocks.en: We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), illustrated in Figure 1 , which changes the rollout sampler of OPD and nothing else. At each position the student proposes a token, and the coupling with a tempered target q α ∝ p S 1 − α ​ p T α q_{\alpha}\propto p_{\mathrm{S}}^{1-\alpha}p_{\mathrm{T}}^{\alpha} either keeps it or substitutes a token from the residual mass that the student underweights. Every emitted token is an exact draw from q α q_{\alpha} , the probability of an intervention equals the total-variation distance between p S p_{\mathrm{S}} and q α q_{\alpha} , and α = 0 \alpha=0 recovers OPD bit for bit. The loss, the teacher, and the number of training steps stay as they are; only the distribution of training states moves toward the teacher. That shift is the source of the gain. The coupling is how CoRD reaches the shifted states while rewriting as little of the student’s own text as any exact sampler of q α q_{\alpha} can, and it splits every draw into an acceptance decision and a replacement direction, which Section 5 tests separately.

blocks.en: The shift pays off on public benchmarks. Across six base students from two model families, CoRD improves average pass@1 and pass@8 over OPD on MATH500, AIME24, AIME25, AMC23 and GSM8K for every student in Table 1 ; on Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B, SKD’s published replacement rule Xu et al. (2025) , with the same loss and budget, lands between OPD and CoRD , and OPD trained for twice as many steps does not catch up. The difficulty breakdown shows that each student’s largest pass@16 gain is on problems it rarely or never solved before training, although the aggregate pass@16 gain is not positive for every student. Substitution rules that intervene at least as often but draw the replacement from elsewhere, namely a uniform token, a token from the student’s average distribution, or a teacher sample at randomly chosen positions, stay at or near OPD and far below CoRD , which ties the gain to where the rollouts are steered rather than to the act of intervening.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We measure the blind spot of on-policy distillation on frozen sets of teacher-reached states, where the student starts 1.5 to 2.4 times further from the teacher than on its own states, and show that OPD leaves most of it in place. • We propose CoRD , which trains on rollouts from a teacher-leaning target and realizes them with the speculative-decoding rejection sampler: exact draws from the target with the fewest possible replacements (the total-variation distance), and OPD as the special case α = 0 \alpha=0 . • We show gains in average pass@1 and pass@8 over OPD for all six base students on five public math benchmarks, and study teacher-reached states through closure measurements, substitution controls and an α \alpha sweep.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Distillation trains a student to match a teacher’s output distribution Hinton et al. (2015) ; Rao et al. (2024) ; Jin et al. (2026) , extended to sequences generated by the teacher Kim and Rush (2016) and to other divergences Wen et al. (2023) ; Xu et al. (2024) survey the area. On-policy methods evaluate the loss on the student’s own samples Lin et al. (2020) ; Agarwal et al. (2024) ; Fu et al. (2026) ; Rao et al. (2026b) and now train production models Yang et al. (2025) ; Lu and Thinking Machines Lab (2025) . DistiLLM Ko et al. (2024) ; Ko et al. (2025) mixes fixed and student-generated outputs under a skewed divergence, and TAID Shing et al. (2025) moves the training target from the student toward the teacher over training. These methods change the loss, its target, or the data mix Chen et al. (2026) ; Rao et al. (2026a) ; Rao et al. (2026c) ; CoRD keeps the on-policy loss and target and changes only where the states come from, so it applies unchanged to any per-state loss computed from both distributions.

blocks.en: Training on states the model would not visit at test time is the exposure-bias problem Bengio et al. (2015) ; Ranzato et al. (2016) . Scheduled sampling mixes reference and model tokens under a hand-set schedule Bengio et al. (2015) ; SEARN, DAgger and MiniLLM roll out a mixture of expert and learner Daumé III et al. (2009) ; Ross et al. (2011) ; Gu et al. (2024) , the last with importance weights. Their mixing follows a schedule or a fixed probability; in CoRD the probability of intervening at a token is the current disagreement itself, so no schedule is needed and interventions vanish as student and target agree. Section 5 includes a DAgger-style control with the same average rate.
blocks.zh: 在测试时,该模型不会访问的关于状态的培训是暴露-偏见问题Bengio等人(2015年);Ramzato等人(2016年)。 根据手定时间表Bengio等人(2015年);SEARN、Dagger和MiniLLM推出专家和学习者Daumé III等人(2009年);Ross等人(2011年);Gu等人(2024年)的混合物,最后一份具有重要性。 它们的混合遵循一个时间表或一个固定的概率;在CORD中,以某种名义介入的概率是当前的分歧本身,因此不需要时间表,干预随着学生和目标的认同而消失. 第5节包括一个DAgger式的控制,平均率相同.

blocks.en: Speculative decoding lets a draft model propose tokens that a rejection sampler accepts or replaces so that the output follows the target exactly Leviathan et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023) ; the sampler is a maximal coupling Lindvall (1992) . DistillSpec Zhou et al. (2024) uses distillation to improve the draft; CoRD conversely uses the sampler to improve distillation. Other recent work lets the teacher take over parts of the rollout when the student drifts Xu et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Liu et al. (2026b) , draws rollouts from a weaker negative policy Hwang et al. (2026) , or repairs the OPD objective itself Fu et al. (2026) ; none samples from an explicit target with an exact rejection rule. The closest prior work is SKD Xu et al. (2025) , where a student proposal outside the teacher’s top- K K tokens is replaced by a teacher sample. Its replacement can be any teacher token, including ones the student already overweights, and its acceptance set is fixed by K K , so its intervention rate is not tied to the distance between the two distributions. CoRD replaces only from the residual ( q α − p S ) + (q_{\alpha}-p_{\mathrm{S}})_{+} , emits tokens that follow q α q_{\alpha} exactly, intervenes at the rate TV ⁡ ( p S , q α ) \mathrm{TV}(p_{\mathrm{S}},q_{\alpha}) , and moves continuously from OPD ( α = 0 \alpha=0 ) to teacher-weighted states ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ). Section 4.3 compares the two under the same loss.

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that CoRD improves average pass@1 and pass@8 over OPD for all six students. Average pass@1 rises by 0.9 to 2.0 percentage points and average pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points across the five benchmarks. Pass@16 is less uniform (Appendix Table 6 ): Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B gain 3.0 and 4.6 points on average, respectively, while Qwen3-1.7B is 0.1 points lower. Table 2 locates the largest within-student pass@16 gains: grouping all 1,919 problems by how many of 16 samples the untrained student solved, every student’s largest gain is on problems solved at most three times initially, reaching 5.9 points on never-solved problems for Qwen3.5-4B and 6.2 points on rarely solved ones for Qwen3-0.6B. This difficulty breakdown need not imply a positive aggregate pass@16 difference for every student.

blocks.en: 4.2 Learning Curves
blocks.zh: 4.2 学习曲线

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows how the two samplers train. The reverse KL at the visited states, averaged over five steps, stays higher under CoRD for every student throughout the 80 steps: the coupled sampler keeps routing the rollouts through states where the student is still far from the teacher, so the loss at the visited states stays larger, whereas on OPD’s own states it quickly falls. On a held-out slice of the training distribution, CoRD ends above OPD for all six students.
blocks.zh: 图3显示两个采样员是如何训练的。 访问州的反向KL(平均超过5个步骤),在CORD下,每名学生在80个步骤中都保持较高水平:联合采样员在学生离教师还很远的州里不断进行推广,因此访问州的亏损仍然较大,而在OPD自己的州里则迅速下降。 在培训分配的搁置部分上,CORD结束于OPD之上,面向所有6名学生。

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with SKD
blocks.zh: 4.3 与SKD的比较

blocks.en: SKD Xu et al. (2025) also lets the teacher intervene in the student’s rollout. To compare the two sampling rules alone, we run SKD’s published rule, which replaces a proposal outside the teacher’s top 25 tokens by a teacher sample, with the same reverse KL loss, data, steps and per-step cost, for Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base and Qwen3.5-2B-Base; these are the rows “SKD” in Table 1 . SKD lands between OPD and CoRD on both averages for both students: it gains 0.6 and 0.2 points of average pass@1 over OPD, respectively, where CoRD gains 1.1 and 0.9 points. The two rules differ in how often, where and with what they intervene. With K = 25 K=25 , SKD replaces fewer than 1% of the tokens, 0.7% and 0.6% on average over training, because the student’s proposal almost always falls inside the teacher’s top 25 even where the two distributions differ substantially; CoRD replaces 6.8% and 5.7%, exactly the total-variation distance to its target. A top- K K rule asks whether the student’s token is plausible to the teacher, and where both models spread their mass over many reasonable continuations it accepts almost every proposal; the coupling moves exactly the excess of the target over the student, so supervision shifts toward the teacher wherever the two distributions differ, in proportion to how much they differ.
blocks.zh: SKD 软件 徐等人(2025年)也让老师介入学生的推出. 仅比较两个采样规则,我们运行了SKD公布的规则,该规则用一个教师样本取代教师前25个符号以外的一个提案,并用相同的反向KL损失,数据,步骤和每步成本,用于Quen3.5-0.8B-Base和Quen3.5-2B-Base;这些是表1中的"SKD"一行. SKD在OPD和CORD两个学生的平均值之间着陆:分别比OPD获得0.6和0.2分平均通过@1,CORD获得1.1和0.9分. 这两项规则在干预的次数、地点和内容上各不相同。 K = 25 K = 25, SKD取代了不到1%的代币,平均比培训高出0.7%和0.6%,因为即使两种分布差异很大,学生的建议几乎总是在教师前25名之内; CORD取代了6.8%和5.7%,正好是其目标的总变异距离。 一个顶级KK规则询问学生的标志对教师来说是否合理,如果两个模型在很多合理续作中分布质量,它几乎接受每一个建议;这种组合完全将目标超过学生,因此,无论两种分布有多么不同,监督都转向教师。

blocks.en: 4.4 OPD with Twice the Steps
blocks.zh: 4.4 发展办公室,两步

blocks.en: Because the coupled rollout queries the teacher during generation, we also give OPD twice the training steps: we train OPD on Qwen3.5-2B-Base for 160 steps, twice as many as CoRD . The extra steps do not help. The corresponding “OPD, 160 steps” row in Table 1 has average pass@1 of 15.1 and pass@8 of 35.6, below the 80-step OPD values of 16.0 and 35.7 and the 80-step CoRD values of 16.9 and 37.5.

blocks.en: 5 Learning in the Blind Spot
blocks.zh: 5 在盲点学习

blocks.en: We now ask where the gains come from. The analyses in this section distill the instruction-tuned Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B-Base, called 1.7B and 4B below, from Qwen3-8B-Base on MATH Hendrycks et al. (2021) for 40 steps, otherwise with the recipe of Section 4 .

blocks.en: Before training we freeze two sets of states for each student: states reached by the untrained student’s own rollouts, and states reached when the untrained student’s rollouts are coupled to the teacher ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ). At the start, the divergence on teacher-reached states is 2.4 times that on student-reached states for the 1.7B student and 1.5 times for the 4B student; for the three Qwen3 base students of Table 1 it is 1.9, 1.7 and 1.5 times.

On teacher-reached states CoRD closes 44.4% of the gap at 1.7B against 37.4% for OPD, and 21.7% against 15.0% at 4B. blocks.en: A natural objection is that any perturbation of the rollout would help by diversifying the training states. We test three alternatives. Two keep the acceptance test of CoRD and replace the residual draw by a uniform random token or by a token drawn from the student’s average token distribution. The third, in the spirit of DAgger, lets the teacher act at randomly chosen positions: at each position the teacher’s own sample replaces the student’s with a probability equal to CoRD ’s batch-mean replacement probability at that step, so the amount of intervention is comparable but its placement ignores where the two models disagree. At 1.7B all three intervene at least as often as CoRD in Table 3 , yet none comes close: the random and frequency rules fall below OPD on both students, and the DAgger-style mixing stays within two points of it. Off-direction replacements steer the rollout into states that neither model prefers; at the first step the mean total-variation distance between student and teacher along the rollouts is 0.40 with uniform replacements against 0.15 with residual draws, so these rules spend the training signal on states that do not lead toward the teacher. The 4B student shows the same picture: at the first step a uniform replacement intervenes on 13.3% of the tokens, twice CoRD ’s 6.9%, and leaves the visited states twice as far from the teacher, with a mean total-variation distance of 0.22 against 0.11.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的反对意见是,任何干扰推出的做法都会有助于培训国家的多样化。 我们测试三种选择。 两人保留CORD的接受测试,用统一的随机符号或从学生平均符号分配中抽取的符号来代替剩余图纸. 第三,本着Dagger的精神,让老师以随机选择的位置行事:在每个位置上,老师自己的样本以相当于CORD的批次-正数替换概率取代学生的概率,因此干预量是可比较的,但其放置忽略了两种模式不一致的地方. 在1.7B时,所有三个都至少像表3中的CoRD那样频繁介入,然而没有一个接近:两个学生的随机规则和频率规则都低于OPD,Dagger风格的混合停留在其中的两个点之内. 非定向替换引导推出的状态为两个模型都不喜欢的状态;在推出过程中,学生和教师之间的平均总变异距离为0.40,统一替换0.15,剩余抽取0.15,因此这些规则将培训信号花在了没有引导老师的状态上. 4B学生展现了同样的情况:第一步,统一更换对13.3%的代币进行干预,是CoRD的6.9%的两倍,使受访的州离老师有两倍的距离,平均总变化距离为0.22对0.11.

blocks.en: The parameter α \alpha sets how far the target leans toward the teacher, and with it how often the sampler intervenes. Table 4 shows a clear trend: closure on teacher-reached states grows with α \alpha at both scales, and each tested α > 0 \alpha>0 closes more of the teacher-side gap than OPD. On the public benchmarks after 80 steps, every α > 0 \alpha>0 also improves pass@16 over OPD.
blocks.zh: 参数 α\ alpha 设定目标向老师倾斜的距离, 以及采样者介入的频率。 表4显示了一个明显的趋势:在两个尺度上,教师接触的状态的关闭随着α-α的增长而增加,每个测试的α > 0\α>0 与OPD相比,教师与教师之间的缺口缩小了更多。 在80个步骤之后的公共基准上,每个α > 0\ alpha>0也比OPD提高16分.

blocks.en: Accuracy can rise because the student formats answers more reliably or because the answers it commits to are more often correct. On the public benchmarks almost every sample ends in an extractable answer, 99.5 to 99.9% for every run of Table 1 , so the pass@1 gains of Table 1 are gains in the correctness of the student’s answers, not in their form.
blocks.zh: 准确性可以上升,因为学生格式的回答更可靠,或者因为它承诺的答案更经常正确. 在公共基准上,几乎每个样本都以一个可提取的答案结尾,表1的每一行99.5-99.9%,因此表1的通过@1收益是学生答案正确性的收获,而不是其形式。

blocks.en: Because the replacement probability equals the current total-variation distance, the sampler withdraws as the student approaches the target. Figure 4 shows that in the 80-step run at 4B, the replacement rate falls from 6.9% at the first step to 4.9% at step 80, without any schedule.
blocks.zh: 由于置换概率等于当前总变异距离,取样者随着学生接近目标而退出. 图4显示,在4B的80步运行中,更换率从第一步的6.9%下降到第80步的4.9%,没有任何时间表。

blocks.en: With Qwen3-14B as the teacher of the 1.7B student for 20 steps, CoRD again closes more of the teacher-side gap than OPD, by 4.2 points, so the gain carries over to a second, larger teacher.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: On-policy distillation supervises the student only where the student already goes. CoRD widens that set by sampling each rollout from the maximal coupling of the student and a teacher-leaning target: the student’s token is kept where the two agree, and a token from the residual is substituted where they do not, exactly as often as they disagree. The loss, the data and the number of training steps stay as they are, and the method adds a single parameter: α = 0 \alpha=0 is OPD exactly, and one value, α = 0.6 \alpha=0.6 , serves all six students. The interventions need no schedule, because the replacement rate falls by itself as the student approaches the target. Across six base students from two model families on public benchmarks, this change improves average pass@1 and pass@8 for all six students. Pass@16 gains are more variable, but each student’s largest difficulty-bin gain occurs on problems it rarely or never solved before training. Frozen sets of teacher-reached states show that CoRD closes more of the gap on exactly the states the teacher reaches. Because the sampler needs only the teacher’s logits during generation, it combines with any change to the loss or its target.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏只监督学生已经去的地方. CORD通过从学生的最大结合点和寻找教师的目标中取样来扩大设定的范围:学生的标志保存在双方同意的地方,其余的标志则被替换在他们不同意的地方,这与他们不同意的一样频繁。 损失,数据和培训步骤的数量保持不变,方法增加了一个单一参数:α = 0\alpha=0是OPD,一个值α = 0.6\alpha=0.6,为所有六名学生服务. 干预措施不需要时间表,因为学生接近目标时更替率本身就下降。 根据公共基准,来自两个模范家庭的6个基础学生的这一变化提高了所有6名学生的平均通过率@1和通过率@8。 Pass@16增益比较多变, 被冻结的几套与教师接触的州表明,CORD在教师所到达的州缩小了更多的差距。 由于采样员在一代人中只需要老师的对数,它与损失或目标的任何变化结合在一起.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: CoRD needs the teacher’s logits during the rollout. Our public-benchmark experiments cover base students up to 4B parameters and teachers up to 9B (14B in one analysis), all on mathematical reasoning; larger models and other tasks are untested. Student and teacher must share a tokenizer. The AIME sets each contain only 30 problems, so small differences in pass rates should be interpreted cautiously.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 我们的公共基准实验覆盖了最多4B参数的基学生和最多9B的教师(一次分析为14B),都涉及数学推理;更大的模型和其他任务没有经过测试. 学生和老师必须共享一种示意剂. AIME各套只包含30个问题,因此通过率的微小差异应该谨慎解释.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work studies model distillation using public mathematical data and benchmarks; it involves no human subjects or personal data. Improving a student’s ability to follow a stronger model can also transfer that model’s errors, biases, or unsafe behavior, and the resulting capabilities may be used outside the evaluated setting. Our experiments therefore should not be interpreted as a safety evaluation or as evidence that distilled models are reliable in high-stakes applications. We encourage evaluation for the intended deployment context, including independent accuracy and safety checks, before use.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究利用公共数学数据和基准进行蒸馏模型研究;它不涉及人类主题和个人数据。 提高学生遵循更强大模式的能力也可以转移该模式的错误、偏见或不安全行为,由此产生的能力可能被用于评价背景之外。 因此,我们的实验不应被解释为安全评价或蒸馏模型在高吸量应用中是可靠的证据。 我们鼓励对预定的部署情况进行评价,包括使用前的独立准确性和安全检查。
